$comment: CANONICAL ROLE LIST — single source of truth for both apps (miv frontend + miv-backend Payload). Any role name used in code MUST match a `value` in this file. Draft pending review with June + PO (see RBAC_MATRIX.md).

roles.label: Founder
roles.description: Venture founder. Sees/edits only their own venture's data. First role to release.

roles.label: Admin
roles.description: Full system access, including destructive operations and system settings. Second release.

roles.label: MIV Analyst
roles.description: MIV staff. Read/write across ventures, documents, and media; no destructive system operations. Third release.

roles.label: Mentor
roles.description: DO NOT BUILD. No dashboards, no access rules, no UI until a permissions matrix for this role is formally documented and approved.

roles.label: Investor
roles.description: DO NOT BUILD. No dashboards, no access rules, no UI until a permissions matrix for this role is formally documented and approved.

unresolvedLegacyRoles.$comment: Roles that exist in code today but have no canonical mapping. DECISION REQUIRED at June/PO review: map each to a canonical role or delete it (with a data migration for any users holding it).

adoption.backend: Generate the `role` select options in miv-backend/src/collections/users.ts from this file (import JSON, map roles where status === 'active').
adoption.frontend: Migrate prisma UserRole enum values to the snake_case canonical values via a Prisma migration + data migration for seeded users; regenerate client.
adoption.ci: Add a check in each app that fails the build if a role string literal is used that is not present in this file.
